info.name: CSN Backend — E2E Smoke Tests
info.description:
44 requests covering all 12 CSN backend services in workflow order.
Run with Collection Runner — the Register request auto-generates a unique email/mobile per run, and IDs chain automatically via test scripts.
Requires all services running on ports 3001–3012.
No separate environment needed; all variables are collection-scoped.
